text:
[issue by MarGar12]
### Minecraft Version

1.21.1

### What happened?

As soon as I updated to 9.4.2, I am immediately kicked out without being able to join. When I downgraded back to 9.4.1, I am able to join just fine

### Relevant Log Outputs

https://paste.ee/p/zaBVEQMM

[comment by TheIllusiveC4 (owner)]
Do you have a list of your installed mods? Also, what error is given on the server's side?

[comment by TheIllusiveC4 (owner)]
I replicated your mod list and am unable to reproduce this error, I can join my test server fine with Curios 9.4.2 installed. Can you try updating both your NeoForge version and all of your mod versions to the latest available and see if that resolves your issue?

[comment by MarGar12 (none)]
Fixed the issue! The cause was because of the server having an outdated version of NeoForge, my bad o3o
